verdicts.reasoning: The items instruct the student to generate or construct a sequence based on a given start value and rule (e.g. "Create a pattern that starts at 1 and uses the rule: Add 3 each time" in seed 11), asking them to select the resulting sequence from the options.
The sequences include both arithmetic increases (e.g., "Add 3 each time" in seed 11) and decreases (e.g., "Subtract 1 each time" in seed 23, "Subtract 2 each time" in seed 103).
Every seed revolves around following a repeating rule (a pattern) applied sequentially to a starting number to generate a list of numbers.
